notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

---

notes.title: Ver 1.12.0 Patch Notes - 9/5/2017
notes.notes:
Added hit effects.
You can turn off the bleeding effect with CONFIG.
Adjustment of AI.
Until now, enemy AI could only travel a limited distance from the reef.
Now, after receiving damage from the player, they will continue battle functions indefinitely.
(You will need to take care to avoid long ranged attacks.) 
Altered the tracking ability of anti-submarine missiles.
The tracking ability of anti-submarine missiles has been strengthened.

notes.title: Ver 1.11.0 Patch Notes - 03/20/2017
notes.notes:
Today we have a few updates for you all. 

Improved graphics.
You can now enjoy more beautiful graphics by changing your settings: "Config">"Graphic Quality" change to "Fantastic".
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23337553/89e0aee79948388efd2c8b6e5aaa1e08ff6cbc9b.png

Examples:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23337553/622c55be58f7a0d6df8334ddc9584b82a3881710.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23337553/92c26345e75c74f10143dc183b0d9fcac9fbd355.png

Network coop
You can cooperate with other PCs to advance in battle.
Please select "Online" in the Reef Menu.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23337553/750dd8fdbc09254aab0a9237db875ac6d6bfc4bc.png

Lock on Control
You can now lock on to a specific object.
Please change the setting "Control Type" to "Normal" on the pause screen and execute the tutorial.
 If you like the previous control setting, you can return to it by changing the setting "Control Type" to "Legacy".
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23337553/0ef1231821765f779a70ba4fa7cff90a4f1f2a61.png

Bug fixes and Improved creature behavior.
